spans.s: प्रति—यामिनि ind. every night, Kathās.
प्रति—युवति f. a concubine, female rival, Vcar.
प्रति—युवम् ind. towards the young man, Śiś. viii, 35.
प्रति—यूथप m. the leader of a hostile herd (of elephants), MBh.
प्रति—यूपम् ind. post by post, ĀpŚr.
प्रति—योगम् ind. rule by rule, Pat.
प्रति—योनि॑ ind. according to source or origin, ŚBr.
प्रति-√ यज् P. -यजति, to sacrifice in return or with an aim towards anything (acc.), ŚBr.; ĀpŚr.
प्रति-˚याग a sacrifice offered with an aim towards anything, ĀpŚr., Sch.

प्रति-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to guard against, counteract, ŚBr.; Śak. i, 32/33 (v.l.) :
Caus. यातयति, to retaliate, requite (with वैरम्, or ˚रणि, ‘to take revenge’), MBh.
प्रति-˚यत्न m. care bestowed upon anything, effort, endeavour, exertion, Pāṇ. i, 3, 32
preparation, elaboration, manufacture, Śiś. iii, 54 (cf. अ-प्र्˚-पूर्व)
imparting a new quality or virtue, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 53
retaliation, requital, W.
(also = लिप्सा, उपग्रह or ˚हण, निग्रहादि, ग्रहणादि, प्रतिग्रह, L.)
प्रति-˚यत्न mfn. exerting one's self, taking care or trouble, L.
cautious, heedful, Jātakam.
प्रति-˚यातन n. requital, retaliation (वैर-प्र्˚, ‘taking revenge’), MBh.
प्रति-˚यातना f. an image, model, counterpart, a picture, statue (of a god &c.), Ragh.; Śiś.; Hcar.
(ifc.) appearing in the shape of Hcar.
प्रति-√ यभ् (only inf. -यब्धुम्), to have intercourse with a female, TBr., Sch.
प्रति-˚यात mfn. gone towards or against or back or away, turned, returned, opposed, MBh.; R.
प्रति-˚यात—निद्र mfn. ‘one whose sleep is gone’, awakened, wake, BhP.
प्रति-˚यात—बुद्धि mfn. one whose mind is turned towards (dat.), R.
प्रति-√ यु P. -यौति, to tie to, bind, fetter, TS.
प्रति-˚युत mfn. tied to, bound, fettered, ib.
प्रति-˚युवन n. repeated mixture, Hcat.
प्रति-˚योग m. resistance, opposition, contradiction, controversy, BhP.
an antidote, remedy, Kathās.
cooperation, association, W.
the being a counterpart of anything, ib.
प्रति-˚योगि in comp. = ˚योगिन्
प्रति-˚योगि—ज्ञान-कारणता f. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगि—ज्ञान-कारणता-वाद m. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगि—ज्ञानस्य हेतुत्व-खण्डन n. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगि—ता f. correlation, dependent existence, Bhāṣāp., Sch.
mutual co-operation, partnership, W.
प्रति-˚योगि—ता-वाद m. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगि—त्व n. = -ता, Tarkas.
प्रति-˚योगि—निरूपण n. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚यो˚ग्यनधिकरणे नाशस्योत्पत्ति-निरास m. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगिक mfn. antithetical, relative, correlative (-त्व n.), Tarkas.; Vedāntap.
प्रति-˚योगिक—त्व n.
प्रति-˚योगिन् mfn. id., Tarkas.; Śaṃk.; TS., Sch. &c. (cf. अ-प्रतिय्˚)
प्रति-˚योगिन् m. an adversary, rival, Mcar.
any object dependent upon another and not existing without it, W.
a partner, associate, ib.
a counterpart, match, ib.
प्रति-˚योजयितव्य mfn. to be fitted with strings, Ragh.

प्रति-√ युध् Ā. P. -युध्यते, ˚ति, to fight against, be a match for (acc.), fight, MBh.; Hariv.; R. :
Caus. -योधयति id., MBh.; Var.
प्रति-˚युद्ध mfn. fought against, fought, R.
प्रति-˚युद्ध n. fighting against, battle in return, Hariv.
प्रति-˚योद्धव्य mfn. to be attacked in return, MBh.
प्रति-˚योद्धृ m. an antagonist, adversary, well-matched opponent, ib.; R.
one who begins a battle, Mn. xi, 81 (v.l.)
प्रति-˚योध m. an opponent, adversary, MBh.; Ragh.
प्रति-˚योधन n. fighting against, assailing in turn, MBh.
प्रति-˚योधिन् m. an antagonist, well-matched opponent g. गम्य्-आदि (cf. अ-प्रतिय्˚).
